title: Screener
description: Every tracked stock at once: valuation, growth, margins, leverage and price moves, filtered by holdings, sector, region and size, and sorted by any of them. Fundamentals come from the screener_fundamentals view (refreshed after each fundamentals ingest), prices are live.

links.title: Add tickers
links.tooltip: Track another stock (or edit the watchlist) on the Manage dashboard

list.name: universe
list.label: List
list.description: Every tracked stock, only your holdings, only the watchlist, or the stocks on neither.
list.query: All : all, Holdings : held, Watchlist : watchlist, Neither : other

list.name: sector
list.label: Sector
list.description: Yahoo Finance's sector; Unclassified until the daily ingest classifies a new ticker.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(sector, 'Unclassified') FROM instruments WHERE kind = 'equity' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(sector, 'Unclassified') FROM instruments WHERE kind = 'equity' ORDER BY 1

list.name: region
list.label: Region
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(region, 'Unclassified') FROM instruments WHERE kind = 'equity' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(region, 'Unclassified') FROM instruments WHERE kind = 'equity' ORDER BY 1

list.name: min_mcap
list.label: Market cap
list.description: Smallest market cap shown, in the selected currency.

list.name: display_currency
list.label: Currency
list.description: The currency market caps are shown in. Ratios, margins and returns don't depend on it.
list.query: SELECT 'USD' AS currency UNION SELECT split_part(symbol, '/', 1) FROM instruments WHERE kind = 'forex' AND symbol LIKE '%/USD' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT 'USD' AS currency UNION SELECT split_part(symbol, '/', 1) FROM instruments WHERE kind = 'forex' AND symbol LIKE '%/USD' ORDER BY 1

list.name: sort
list.label: Sort by
list.description: The table's order; stocks without the figure go last. Clicking a column header sorts by it instead.
list.query: Market cap (largest first) : mcap, P/E (lowest first) : pe, P/FCF (lowest first) : pfcf, EV/EBITDA (lowest first) : ev_ebitda, Revenue growth (highest first) : revenue_growth, EPS growth (highest first) : eps_growth, Operating margin (highest first) : op_margin, ROE (highest first) : roe, 1Y return (highest first) : chg_1y, Below 52-week high (furthest first) : below_high_52w, Next earnings (soonest first) : next_earnings, Symbol (A to Z) : symbol

list.name: columns
list.label: Columns
list.description: Which groups of columns the Stocks table shows; Symbol, Name, Sector and market cap always show.
list.query: Overview : Symbol\,Name\,Sector\,Mkt cap\,List\,P/E\,EV/EBITDA\,Rev growth\,Op margin\,ROE\,Debt/EBITDA\,1Y\,Next earnings, Valuation : Symbol\,Name\,Sector\,Mkt cap\,P/E\,P/FCF\,P/B\,EV/EBITDA, Growth : Symbol\,Name\,Sector\,Mkt cap\,Rev growth\,EPS growth\,Shares YoY, Profitability : Symbol\,Name\,Sector\,Mkt cap\,Gross margin\,Op margin\,Net margin\,ROE, Debt : Symbol\,Name\,Sector\,Mkt cap\,Debt/Eq\,Debt/EBITDA, Price : Symbol\,Name\,Sector\,Mkt cap\,Price\,Ccy\,1M\,YTD\,1Y\,5Y/yr\,vs 200d\,Off 52w high, Details : Symbol\,Name\,Sector\,Mkt cap\,Region\,List\,Next earnings

panels.title: Stocks
panels.description: How many of the stocks the selectors pick; the table's column filters can narrow it further.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS ( SELECT e.*, e.mcap * CASE WHEN e.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE fx_usd_rate(e.currency, e.price_date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', e.price_date), 0) END AS mcap_ccy FROM equity_screener e WHERE e.sector IN ($sector) AND e.region IN ($region) AND ('$universe' = 'all' OR ('$universe' = 'held' AND e.held) OR ('$universe' = 'watchlist' AND e.watched) OR ('$universe' = 'other' AND NOT e.held AND NOT e.watched)) ), picked AS ( SELECT s.* FROM s WHERE $min_mcap = 0 OR s.mcap_ccy >= $min_mcap ) SELECT count(*) AS "Stocks" FROM picked s

panels.title: Median P/E
panels.description: The median P/E (TTM) of the stocks the selectors pick, among those with one.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS ( SELECT e.*, e.mcap * CASE WHEN e.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE fx_usd_rate(e.currency, e.price_date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', e.price_date), 0) END AS mcap_ccy FROM equity_screener e WHERE e.sector IN ($sector) AND e.region IN ($region) AND ('$universe' = 'all' OR ('$universe' = 'held' AND e.held) OR ('$universe' = 'watchlist' AND e.watched) OR ('$universe' = 'other' AND NOT e.held AND NOT e.watched)) ), picked AS ( SELECT s.* FROM s WHERE $min_mcap = 0 OR s.mcap_ccy >= $min_mcap ) SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pe) AS "Median P/E" FROM picked s

panels.title: Stocks
panels.description:
Every tracked stock the selectors at the top pick, one row each.

- **Sort** with *Sort by* (stocks without the figure go last), or click a column header.
- **Filter** a column with the funnel in its header: pick an operator such as `<` or `>`, type a value, tick *Select all*, untick *(Blanks)* to drop stocks without the figure, then *Ok*. The count at the bottom follows.
- **Columns** at the top picks which groups of columns show.
- Click a **symbol** for its Valuation or Financial Statements dashboard.

Fundamentals are the latest reported, as on the Valuation dashboard: TTM means the last four quarters, or the fiscal year as filed. A figure is blank when its report ended more than about 15 months before the latest close, and where it means nothing (a multiple of a loss, of negative equity or of negative cash flow).

- **Mkt cap**: latest close × diluted shares, at that day's exchange rate; blank until the rate is stored.
- **P/E**: latest close over TTM diluted EPS, with the close in the currency the company reports in. **P/FCF** and **P/B**: market cap over TTM free cash flow (operating cash flow less capex) and over book equity. **EV/EBITDA**: market cap plus debt less cash, over TTM operating income plus D&A.
- **Rev growth**, **EPS growth**: TTM against the TTM closest to a year earlier, in the reporting currency, at the latest report that has one. **Shares YoY**: diluted shares against a year earlier; green is buybacks, red dilution.
- **Gross**, **Op** and **Net margin**: TTM gross profit, operating income and net income over revenue. **ROE**: TTM net income over book equity.
- **Debt/Eq**, **Debt/EBITDA**: total debt over book equity, and over TTM EBITDA.
- **Price**: latest close, in the listing currency (**Ccy**). **1M**, **YTD**, **1Y**: against the last close at least that long ago (YTD: last year's last close). **5Y/yr**: price return over five years, per year, dividends not included. **vs 200d**: against the average of the last 200 closes. **Off 52w high**: below the highest close of the last year.
- **List**: *Holding* is an open position in the portfolio, *Watchlist* is on the watchlist.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS ( SELECT e.*, e.mcap * CASE WHEN e.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE fx_usd_rate(e.currency, e.price_date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', e.price_date), 0) END AS mcap_ccy FROM equity_screener e WHERE e.sector IN ($sector) AND e.region IN ($region) AND ('$universe' = 'all' OR ('$universe' = 'held' AND e.held) OR ('$universe' = 'watchlist' AND e.watched) OR ('$universe' = 'other' AND NOT e.held AND NOT e.watched)) ), picked AS ( SELECT s.* FROM s WHERE $min_mcap = 0 OR s.mcap_ccy >= $min_mcap ) SELECT s.symbol AS "Symbol", s.name AS "Name", s.sector AS "Sector", s.region AS "Region", CASE WHEN s.held THEN 'Holding' WHEN s.watched THEN 'Watchlist' END AS "List", s.mcap_ccy AS "Mkt cap", s.pe AS "P/E", s.pfcf AS "P/FCF", s.pb AS "P/B", s.ev_ebitda AS "EV/EBITDA", s.revenue_growth AS "Rev growth", s.eps_growth AS "EPS growth", s.shares_change AS "Shares YoY", s.gross_margin AS "Gross margin", s.op_margin AS "Op margin", s.net_margin AS "Net margin", s.roe AS "ROE", s.debt_to_equity AS "Debt/Eq", s.debt_to_ebitda AS "Debt/EBITDA", s.close AS "Price", s.currency AS "Ccy", s.chg_1m AS "1M", s.chg_ytd AS "YTD", s.chg_1y AS "1Y", s.chg_5y_annual AS "5Y/yr", s.vs_ma200 AS "vs 200d", s.below_high_52w AS "Off 52w high", to_char(s.next_earnings, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || CASE WHEN s.next_earnings_estimated THEN ' (est.)' ELSE '' END AS "Next earnings" FROM picked s ORDER BY CASE '$sort' WHEN 'pe' THEN s.pe WHEN 'pfcf' THEN s.pfcf WHEN 'ev_ebitda' THEN s.ev_ebitda END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE '$sort' WHEN 'mcap' THEN s.mcap_ccy WHEN 'revenue_growth' THEN s.revenue_growth WHEN 'eps_growth' THEN s.eps_growth WHEN 'op_margin' THEN s.op_margin WHEN 'roe' THEN s.roe WHEN 'chg_1y' THEN s.chg_1y WHEN 'below_high_52w' THEN s.below_high_52w END DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN '$sort' = 'next_earnings' THEN s.next_earnings END ASC NULLS LAST, s.symbol

panels.title: Sectors
panels.description: The stocks the selectors pick, by sector: how many, their combined market cap, and the median of each figure among the stocks that have it.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS ( SELECT e.*, e.mcap * CASE WHEN e.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE fx_usd_rate(e.currency, e.price_date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', e.price_date), 0) END AS mcap_ccy FROM equity_screener e WHERE e.sector IN ($sector) AND e.region IN ($region) AND ('$universe' = 'all' OR ('$universe' = 'held' AND e.held) OR ('$universe' = 'watchlist' AND e.watched) OR ('$universe' = 'other' AND NOT e.held AND NOT e.watched)) ), picked AS ( SELECT s.* FROM s WHERE $min_mcap = 0 OR s.mcap_ccy >= $min_mcap ) SELECT s.sector AS "Sector", count(*) AS "Stocks", sum(s.mcap_ccy) AS "Mkt cap", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pe) AS "Median P/E", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.ev_ebitda) AS "Median EV/EBITDA", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.revenue_growth) AS "Median revenue growth", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.op_margin) AS "Median op margin", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.roe) AS "Median ROE", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.chg_1y) AS "Median 1Y" FROM picked s GROUP BY s.sector ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST, 1
